kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتزلزل (form IIq)
# أَتَزَلْزَلُ (ʔatazalzalu) /ʔa.ta.zal.za.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَزَلْزَلَ (tazalzala)
# أَتَزَلْزَلَ (ʔatazalzala) /ʔa.ta.zal.za.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَزَلْزَلَ (tazalzala)
# أَتَزَلْزَلْ (ʔatazalzal) /ʔa.ta.zal.zal/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَزَلْزَلَ (tazalzala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
